name: context-bridge-release
description: Mark an outbound context bridge entry as released — stop expecting replies for this outbound message. Use when a delegated conversation is complete or to clear stale context. entry_id must be the UUID copied verbatim from the [ACTIVE OUTBOUND CONTEXT] block. If that block is not present in this turn, there is nothing to release — do not call this tool. For task-wake bindings (context metadata bind_reply + task_id), pass reply with the CEO's answer verbatim to persist it on the originating task and release in one call.

inputs.entry_id: string (UUID copied verbatim from the [ACTIVE OUTBOUND CONTEXT] block. If that block is absent, do not call this tool — there is nothing to release. Do not invent a slug or a composite key.)
